newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt says Netanyahu security-obsessed, needs help.
newsitem.headline: Egypt says Netanyahu security-obsessed, needs help.

text.p: An Egyptian official said on Sunday only a psychiatrist could help Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu overcome an obsession with Israel's security.
The remark was the latest shot in a war of words between Egypt and Israel over the approach to peace talks adopted since Netanyahu come to power through elections in May.

"The Israeli prime minister...has a pathological fear on the security issue, which cannot be solved on the negotiating table but only by a psychiatrist," said Adel el-Safty, undersecretary at the Egyptian foreign ministry.

Since his election, Netanyahu has repeatedly said that Israel's security is his main concern. He has also criticised the dovish former government for giving undertakings to give back occupied Arab land in return for peace.
